name: Coronary Artery Diseases Random Samples (Kaggle, younesselbrag)
n_scans: 29 studies/series (case56-case84; case84 has only 16 slices, so 28 complete), 1 series each
license: CC0: Public Domain (as stated by uploader; provenance undocumented)
steps_to_access: Unauthenticated per-file download works (verified 2026-10-12): curl -L -o OUT "https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/<owner>/<slug>/<url-encoded path>" (large single files arrive wrapped in a .zip; unzip it). File list: GET https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/list/<owner>/<slug>?pageSize=200 (follow nextPageToken). Whole-dataset download: `kaggle datasets download -d <owner>/<slug>` needs a free Kaggle account + API token (project lead must create it). Folder pattern: data3Dicom/caseNN/DATA/ANON2022/<date>/<time>/EX1/SE1/IMG<k>.
provenance: Unknown institution (InstitutionName='Erased'); Philips iCT 256, ProtocolName 'Coronary CTA 90-120KG /Cardiac', StudyDescription 'CT ANGIO-CORONARY ARTERIES', 2022 study dates. Not ImageCAS (different scanner/era). Uploaded 2022-11-09. Case numbering starts at 56, suggesting the uploader holds more cases that were not posted.
verified: Full file list read (9,676 files, 29 case folders). Downloaded 3 slices of case56: Philips iCT 256, 0.9 mm slices, 0.43 mm pixels, 120 kVp, ContrastBolusAgent=Iodine, SeriesDescription '40%, iDose' (ECG-gated 40% phase), p99.5 about 570-620 HU. Deleted afterwards.
notes: Best genuinely new open T1 find in my territory. CC0, but the uploader's right to release it is unverified. Treat as research use and keep the provenance caveat.

name: HeartSR / cardiac-ct-lr-hr (Kaggle, victorsix)
n_scans: 10 patients (P01-P10), each with an HR series (0.6 mm CCTA, ~370-530 slices) and a paired LR series
steps_to_access: Unauthenticated per-file download works (verified 2026-10-12): curl -L -o OUT "https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/<owner>/<slug>/<url-encoded path>" (large single files arrive wrapped in a .zip; unzip it). File list: GET https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/list/<owner>/<slug>?pageSize=200 (follow nextPageToken). Whole-dataset download: `kaggle datasets download -d <owner>/<slug>` needs a free Kaggle account + API token (project lead must create it). Paths: HeartSR/Pxx/HR/*.dcm and HeartSR/Pxx/LR/*.dcm.
provenance: Italian centre ('CARDIO TC CON MDC', protocol 'Cuore_Retrospettivo'), Siemens SOMATOM Force, study dates 2025-07. Independent of ImageCAS.
verified: Full file list read (8,152 files). Downloaded one HR slice: Siemens SOMATOM Force, 'Coro DS_CorCTA 0.6 Bv44 BestDiast 75%', BodyPart HEART, contrast APPLIED, 80 kVp, p99.5 = 862 HU. Rendered axial slice shows an opacified aorta and LV with coronaries. Deleted.
notes: Retrospective ECG-gated CCTA. The LR series are probably reduced-resolution reconstructions of the same scan, so count 10 patients, not 20. Licence unknown, so ask the uploader before sharing derived labels.

name: CAT08 Rotterdam Coronary Artery Evaluation Framework (Kaggle mirror inside apette/heart-data)
format: MetaImage .mhd/.raw (uint16, HU+1024), plus centerline reference .txt files
labels: 4 coronary centerlines per case (training reference standard), Slicer markups
license: Mirror: Unknown. Original CAT08 requires registration and has its own terms (http://coronary.bigr.nl/centerlines/)
steps_to_access: Unauthenticated per-file download works (verified 2026-10-12): curl -L -o OUT "https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/<owner>/<slug>/<url-encoded path>" (large single files arrive wrapped in a .zip; unzip it). File list: GET https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/list/<owner>/<slug>?pageSize=200 (follow nextPageToken). Whole-dataset download: `kaggle datasets download -d <owner>/<slug>` needs a free Kaggle account + API token (project lead must create it). Path: CAT08/CAT08/datasetNN/imageNN.mhd + imageNN.raw. Official route: register at coronary.bigr.nl (project lead).
provenance: Erasmus MC Rotterdam 2008 challenge (Schaap et al. 2009). Independent of ImageCAS. The same Kaggle dataset also mirrors ASOCA (see below).
verified: File list read (32 dataset folders). Downloaded dataset00 image00.mhd/.raw (142.6 MB): 512x512x272, 0.363x0.363x0.4 mm, raw p99.5 = 1445, i.e. about 421 HU after the 1024 offset. Rendered slice shows contrast LV/aorta. Deleted.
notes: Redistribution status of the mirror is doubtful. For shared annotations, get the data through the official registration.

steps_to_access: Unauthenticated per-file download works (verified 2026-10-12): curl -L -o OUT "https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/<owner>/<slug>/<url-encoded path>" (large single files arrive wrapped in a .zip; unzip it). name: ImageCHD (Kaggle, official author account xiaoweixumedicalai)
steps_to_access: Unauthenticated per-file download works (verified 2026-10-12): curl -L -o OUT "https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/download/<owner>/<slug>/<url-encoded path>" (large single files arrive wrapped in a .zip; unzip it). File list: GET https://www.kaggle.com/api/v1/datasets/list/<owner>/<slug>?pageSize=200 (follow nextPageToken). Whole-dataset download: `kaggle datasets download -d <owner>/<slug>` needs a free Kaggle account + API token (project lead must create it). Download all 13 parts, rename ImageCHD_dataset.change2zip to .zip, then unzip the split archive (e.g. `7z x` or `zip -s 0 in.zip --out full.zip`).
provenance: Guangdong Provincial People's Hospital (same hospital as ImageCAS, different patients/cohort, congenital). CHD68 (xiaoweixumedicalai/chd68-segmentation-dataset-miccai19, 68 CT) is very likely a subset of ImageCHD (same group). Do not double count.
verified: Read the zip central directory (110 images + 110 labels). Extracted ct_1178_image.nii.gz from the last part: 512x512x315, int16 0-4095 (offset ~1024), p99.5 = 1622, i.e. about 600 HU, so contrast present. Header spacing is 1 mm (true spacing lost). Deleted.
notes: Coronaries visible but anatomy is congenital. Same-hospital origin as ImageCAS, so check for overlap via scan dates if possible. Non-commercial.
